registration: Before the first formal fit and before any heldout model evaluation
reason: Same-recording duration is common metadata that can support paired retrieval without audiovisual content
primary_profile: time_normalized_v2: every model receives dt=1 at each of32 observations

diagnostics.name: duration_only
diagnostics.input: Original heldout common-interval durations from the sealed feature cache
diagnostics.score: Negative absolute pairwise duration difference; both directions and all-clips/same-actor scopes
diagnostics.interpretation: Quantifies the direct duration shortcut in the superseded unexecuted profile

diagnostics.name: fixed_dt_with_content
diagnostics.interpretation: Primary result with direct per-clip duration metadata removed; ordinary visual/audio nuisance cues remain possible

diagnostics.name: zero_content_original_dt
diagnostics.input: All128 feature coordinates set to0, preserving original variable durations
diagnostics.training: No refit; same validation-selected time-normalized checkpoint
diagnostics.interpretation: Out-of-distribution clock-only counterfactual; not an estimate of original variable-duration training performance

diagnostics.name: zero_content_fixed_dt
diagnostics.input: All feature coordinates0 and dt=1; identical input is evaluated once and predictions are broadcast to every candidate
diagnostics.interpretation: Exact input-constant null control; tied retrieval ranks are broken by registered clip index

timing: After all21 registered main attempts are recorded; only completed jobs with durable validation selection are diagnosed
metrics: Unchanged bidirectional recall1,recall5,MRR with deterministic index tie breaking; recognition accuracy/CE for model counterfactuals
decisions: No diagnostic result can change model choice, optimizer budget, checkpoint selection, test membership or primary endpoint
failures: All incomplete main attempts and diagnostic failures are retained explicitly
cost: Diagnostic process is measured separately by Linux wait4 and added to the study's actual execution cost; no energy estimate
